text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT: Unexpected spike in 429s from rate-limiter after deploy canary (region: eu-central-1). Metric: rl.throttles_count +350% since 2701112000. Triggering oncall: @carla. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/rl/canary-2701112223

carla (oncall): ACK. Im looking at traces and rollout events. josh, which deploy rolled?

josh (deploy): started a progressive rollout of rl-parser-2 at 2701111800, canary at 15% traffic. Deploy id deploy-27011118. No manual overrides documented.

nina (eng): digging into logs: exemption header parsing is returning empty for many legacy tokens. Example header: `X-Exempt-Token: partner-77` -> parsed as `null`. Looks like the parser changed expected header name and casing rules.

theo (sre): consequence: missing exemption interpreted as non-exempt -> token counters increased -> throttle gates firing. Early impact window 2701111800-2701112400. Are customers hitting production errors? cs-rep?

cs-rep: Two customers reported issues via support (FastLogix, MarketOps). Both describe intermittent 429s for valid API keys. Theyre escalated to priority. Notified their CSMs.

carla (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) pause rollout 2) flip feature flag for parser2 3) apply runtime whitelist for critical tokens 4) run accounting backfill. Josh: can you pause?

josh (deploy): pausing canary now. `/deploy pause --id=deploy-27011118` -> acknowledged. Can also force rollback if needed.

ops-bot: command executed: `/service flag set rl_parser_v2 false --env=eu-central-1` -> SUCCESS

nina (eng): pushing a config patch to map legacy header names to new schema in-process while we revert. Patch branch `fix/legacy-exempt-mapping-2701112223`. Will prepare a hotfix if runtime patch insufficient.

amber (ops): I can push whitelist via config API without deploy: `/config update rl runtime_whitelist="fastlogix-key,marketops-key" --region=eu-central-1` -> running

ops-bot: `/config update` returned OK. Whitelist active at 2701112350.

theo (sre): metrics: throttles drop ~60% within 45s of flag flip + whitelist. 5xxs unchanged. Continuing monitoring for any token-accounting residue.

carla (oncall): plan: full rollback of rl-parser-2 from eu-central if whitelist+flag doesn't stabilize to baseline in 10m. Also start ledger audit. Josh, prep rollback.

josh (deploy): initiating rollback: `/deploy rollback --id=deploy-27011118 --regions=eu-central-1` -> started at 2701112440. ETA 4m

ops-bot: rollback finished at 2701112680. Canary instances terminated.

nina (eng): investigative note: parser v2 defaulted to strict header normalization which dropped unknown-cased headers, e.g., `x-exempt-token` vs `X-Exempt-Token`. Our canary routing delivered ~8% of legacy traffic to rl-parser-2 due to routing rule mismatch.

theo (sre): observed that the token-accounting pipeline increments throttle counters immediately when exemption missing; theres no fallback check for nulls. Recommend resilience: treat missing exemption as "unknown" not explicit non-exempt. Creating ticket to adjust counters logic.

carla (oncall): customer impact update: approximate affected requests: 1.2M over window, ~0.7% of total platform traffic, with two elevated support cases. Severity remains P1 until ledger audit completes.

cs-rep: Customer-facing interim note posted: "We've identified a recent canary rollout that caused intermittent throttling for some EU customers. We paused the rollout and rolled back the change. We're auditing for any usage/billing impact and will follow up shortly."

nina (eng): hotfix plan: 1) merge `fix/legacy-exempt-mapping-2701112223` to main 2) deploy as canary behind `rl_parser_v2` OFF 3) run compatibility-only canary at 1% with verbose parsing logs. CI passing locally.

amber (ops): added temporary alert suppression for known noise metric to avoid alert fatigue while we reconcile.

theo (sre): action items for post-incident: - reconcile token counts for affected window - add unit tests for header casing & fallback - add canary gating: compatibility tests against historical header variants

carla (oncall): short action checklist: 
- [x] pause canary (josh)
- [x] flip parser feature flag off (ops-bot)
- [x] runtime whitelist (amber)
- [x] rollback completed (josh)
- [ ] hotfix merge + compatibility canary (nina)
- [ ] ledger/audit for billing (finance + ops)
- [ ] customer follow-up with detailed timeline (cs-rep)

josh (deploy): adding label `requires-postmortem` and assigning to eng-runtime.

incident-bot: NOTE: Please include deploy IDs, affected regions, and customer list in the postmortem. Template: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/template

carla (oncall): keeping channel open until reconciliation job scheduled and CS follow-ups complete. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
